abilities.effect: The giant lizard bumps into lab tables and workbenches, causing dangerous ingredients to intermix and detonate. The hazard rolls initiative.
abilities.name: Explosive Catalyst

hazard.description: Potion bottles, alembics, and potent ingredients violently explode when jostled and accidentally combined.
hazard.disable: three DC 20 Acrobatics or Crafting checks to sort and separate the bottles of volatile ingredients into groups
hazard.name: Volatile Reagents
hazard.reset: The lab contains enough ingredients for this hazard to last 1 minute before all materials are expended. Alternatively, the hazard resets once Slick shrinks to regular size (see below).
hazard.routine: (1 action) A random 10-foot square in Gattlebee's laboratory explodes, dealing 2d6 damage to creatures and objects in the area (DC 18 basic Reflex save). The damage type is randomly determined each round: acid, cold, electricity, fire, slashing, or sonic.

traits.name: Alchemical
traits.text:
Alchemical items are powered by reactions of alchemical reagents. Unless otherwise noted, alchemical items aren’t magical and don’t radiate a magical aura.  
  
Alchemical creatures are partially powered by alchemical reactions.

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.
